name: Russia–Ukraine
blurb: Interstate war between Russia and Ukraine. It has been underway since 2014 and at full scale since February 2022.
complexityNote: Fighting is widely reported in eastern and southern Ukraine, with long-range strikes away from the front. Daily loss figures from either capital are claims, not a shared count.
gdeltQuery: (ukraine OR ukrainian OR kyiv OR kharkiv OR zaporizhzhia OR donetsk) (war OR missile OR drone OR troops OR strike OR front OR army)

inclusion.text: Included because Wikipedia’s list of ongoing armed conflicts groups it among major wars.
inclusion.sourceName: Wikipedia: List of ongoing armed conflicts

name: Gaza and Lebanon
statusLabel: Active war, more than one front
blurb: Fighting in the Gaza Strip between Israeli forces and Palestinian armed groups, with related fighting involving Hezbollah in Lebanon.
complexityNote: This page keeps Gaza and Lebanon together because reporting often links them. It does not treat every event in Israel, the West Bank, or Lebanon as the same battle.

parties.name: Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups

gdeltQuery: (gaza OR hamas OR hezbollah OR rafah) (israel OR israeli OR lebanon OR strike OR troops)

inclusion.text: Included because Wikipedia’s list of ongoing armed conflicts groups the Gaza war and the Israel–Hezbollah fighting among major wars.
inclusion.sourceName: Wikipedia: List of ongoing armed conflicts

name: Iran, Israel, and the United States
statusLabel: Active war, as described by Wikipedia
blurb: Wikipedia describes a war involving the United States, Israel, and Iran since 28 February 2026. The summary on this page is theirs.
complexityNote: Other countries have been named in public reporting about strikes and shipping. This page does not fold all of those events into one order of battle. Sample markers are not locations of real strikes.
gdeltQuery: (iran OR iranian OR tehran OR hormuz) (war OR strike OR missile OR israel OR american OR troops)

inclusion.text: Included because Wikipedia’s list of ongoing armed conflicts describes this war, and because the Wikipedia page “2026 Iran war” calls it ongoing.

name: Sudan
blurb: Civil war in Sudan between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces, ongoing since April 2023.
complexityNote: Local armed groups and foreign governments are also reported as involved. Reducing the war to two logos hides that. Both main parties’ casualty claims are shown when the file has them, and neither is adopted.
gdeltQuery: (sudan OR sudanese OR khartoum OR darfur OR "el fasher") (war OR army OR rsf OR troops OR attack)

inclusion.text: Included because Wikipedia’s list of ongoing armed conflicts groups the Sudanese civil war among major wars.
inclusion.sourceName: Wikipedia: List of ongoing armed conflicts

name: Myanmar
blurb: Civil war in Myanmar between the military and a wide set of resistance and ethnic armed groups, ongoing since the 2021 coup.
complexityNote: The resistance is not one army. Ethnic armed organizations and People’s Defence Forces fight on different fronts. A marker for “the resistance” would flatten that, so sample units stay unnamed.
gdeltQuery: (myanmar OR burmese OR burma) (war OR military OR airstrike OR resistance OR coup OR rakhine)

inclusion.text: Included because Wikipedia’s list of ongoing armed conflicts groups the Myanmar civil war among major wars.
inclusion.sourceName: Wikipedia: List of ongoing armed conflicts

name: Sahel
blurb: Insurgencies in Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger involving state forces, JNIM, and the Islamic State’s Sahel branch.
complexityNote: The Lake Chad fighting associated with Boko Haram is related but is not this page. It can be added as its own conflict in the data file.

parties.name: Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger forces

gdeltQuery: (mali OR "burkina faso" OR niamey OR bamako OR jnim OR sahel) (attack OR army OR militants OR troops OR insurgency)

inclusion.text: Included because Wikipedia’s list of ongoing armed conflicts groups Islamist insurgencies in the Sahel among major wars.

name: Eastern DR Congo
blurb: Fighting in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, including the M23 offensive and other armed groups in North Kivu and Ituri.
complexityNote: M23 is one party among several. ADF and local militias are also regularly reported. Rwanda is accused by Congo’s government of backing M23; Rwanda denies directing the fighting. Those are claims, and this page does not settle them.
gdeltQuery: ("dr congo" OR goma OR "north kivu" OR m23 OR ituri) (rebels OR army OR attack OR troops)

inclusion.text: Included because Wikipedia’s list of ongoing armed conflicts groups fighting in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, including the M23 offensive, among major wars.
inclusion.sourceName: Wikipedia: List of ongoing armed conflicts

name: Yemen and the Red Sea
statusLabel: Active civil war and maritime attacks
blurb: The Yemeni civil war, ongoing since 2014, and attacks in and around the Red Sea claimed by the Houthis.
complexityNote: Yemen’s anti-Houthi camp is itself divided. Saudi Arabia and other states have been parties at different times. Red Sea attacks are related to the wider regional wars and are also tracked here when the wording matches.

parties.name: Internationally recognized government and allied forces

gdeltQuery: (yemen OR houthi OR houthis OR "red sea") (war OR strike OR missile OR ship OR troops)

inclusion.text: Included because Wikipedia’s list of ongoing armed conflicts groups the Yemeni civil war among wars, including Red Sea fighting.
inclusion.sourceName: Wikipedia: List of ongoing armed conflicts

name: Korean Peninsula
blurb: The Korean War stopped in an armistice on 27 July 1953. No peace treaty replaced it. This is not a page of daily battles.
complexityNote: Wikipedia’s list of conflicts with combat deaths this year does not treat Korea as an active battle front. It is here because the owner asked for wars that are still legally unresolved, and because the armistice is not a peace treaty.

parties.name: South Korea and United States forces

gdeltQuery: ("north korea" OR "south korea" OR pyongyang OR dmz) (missile OR drill OR troops OR army OR border)

inclusion.text: Included because the Korean Armistice Agreement of 27 July 1953 halted fighting without a peace treaty. It is labeled an armistice, not an active battle day.

name: Somalia
blurb: Long-running war in Somalia. The current phase is fought mainly between federal forces, their partners, and al-Shabaab.
complexityNote: Federal member states, Islamic State fighters in Puntland, and foreign troops have all appeared in recent public reporting. This page does not treat the country as a two-player front.
gdeltQuery: (somalia OR mogadishu OR "al-shabaab" OR "al shabaab") (attack OR army OR troops OR bombing)

inclusion.text: Included because Wikipedia’s list of ongoing armed conflicts groups the Somali civil war among major wars.
inclusion.sourceName: Wikipedia: List of ongoing armed conflicts

name: Ethiopia
blurb: Several armed conflicts inside Ethiopia since 2018, including fighting involving Fano in Amhara and the Oromo Liberation Army in Oromia.
complexityNote: These are not one battlefield. A national casualty total would mix different wars. Sample figures on this page are illustrations of the layout only.
gdeltQuery: (ethiopia OR amhara OR oromia OR tigray OR fano) (war OR army OR clash OR troops OR drone)

inclusion.text: Included because Wikipedia’s list of ongoing armed conflicts groups wars in Ethiopia among wars with at least 1,000 deaths in the current or previous year.
inclusion.sourceName: Wikipedia: List of ongoing armed conflicts

name: Syria
blurb: Wikipedia treats the 2011 civil war as ended with the fall of the Assad government in December 2024, and still records clashes in Syria in 2026.
complexityNote: The parties are fragmented: current Syrian authorities, local armed groups, and Israeli forces have all been named in public reporting. This page does not call that the same war as 2011–2024.
gdeltQuery: (syria OR syrian OR idlib OR damascus OR aleppo OR suwayda) (clash OR strike OR troops OR army OR israel)

inclusion.text: Included because Wikipedia’s list of ongoing armed conflicts still records fighting in Syria in 2026, under the aftermath of the civil war. The Wikipedia summary itself says many sources treat that civil war as ended in 2024.
inclusion.sourceName: Wikipedia: List of ongoing armed conflicts

name: Nigeria
blurb: The Boko Haram insurgency in the northeast, and armed banditry in the northwest, both treated as ongoing armed conflicts on Wikipedia’s list.
complexityNote: These are not one battlefield. A headline is filed here when it names Nigeria’s war, Boko Haram, or the northwest bandit conflict. Figures stay attached to the outlet that printed them.
gdeltQuery: (nigeria OR "boko haram" OR maiduguri OR zamfara) (attack OR army OR killed OR bandit OR troops)

inclusion.text: Included because Wikipedia’s list of ongoing armed conflicts groups the Boko Haram insurgency and the Nigerian bandit conflict among current wars.
inclusion.sourceName: Wikipedia: List of ongoing armed conflicts

name: Haiti
blurb: Fighting for control of Port-au-Prince and other areas between armed groups and Haitian authorities, with outside security forces also named in public reporting.

gdeltQuery: (haiti OR haitian OR "port-au-prince") (gang OR armed OR police OR attack OR troops)

inclusion.text: Included because Wikipedia’s list of ongoing armed conflicts includes the Haitian conflict.
